notes.title: 7 days before Ranch Simulator Early Access Launch, Catch a Lover 50% discount, DUMMY - free to play now!
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34136964/88dd51fd38c1d944cca3d7c48f43f763ed55b651.png
Dear friends! 
In honor of the upcoming release of Ranch Simulator, which is only a week away, we launch a 50% discount for Catch a Lover, and also make our intellectual quiz DUMMY completely free!

If you haven't already, wishlist and follow Ranch Simulator here on Steam to be notified at release! The game will cost $24.99/£19.99, and there will be launch discount - so don't miss out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1119730

notes.title: Game release and Pack Contest
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34060500/ff0ffb9e1129e8e8fd889a653335d46e9ec75cc6.jpg
The game is released, which means that it's time to play, create, compete, share impressions and suggestions for improving the game! We will try to listen to every your offer!

In honor of the start of sales, we also launch PACK CONTEST!
Starting today, you can post your own pack of questions in the steam workshop and add the following image to the preview of your workshop item, thereby confirming your pack's participation in the competition:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34060500/b7c3a2245c8a79679d03654fbb7a39ffdc1280c6.png
In February, we will summarize and give the winners the following prizes:
 1 place - $ 100 + 4 copies of the game Catch a Lover
2nd place - $ 50 + 4 copies of the game Catch a Lover
3rd place - $ 25 + 4 copies of the game Catch a Lover  
This competition is a test one, and if it arouses the interest of the players, the competitions will be held on a permanent basis.
Rules:
1. A pack of questions can be created on any topic and in any language.
2. When evaluating packs, their workshop statistics and player reviews, as well as the personal opinion of the developers will be taken into account.
3. The presence of the participant label is required.
4. An author can submit many packs for participation, but he can get a prize only for one of them.

You can ask questions about the game or the contest in our official Discord channel.
